shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright slab with a rounded/tapering top
horizontal register divider separating an upper and lower zone
row of repeated similar figures aligned side by side in a band
small filler signs or symbols set between larger figures
justification: Both are upright tapering slabs carved in low relief with content organised into stacked registers separated by a horizontal band, and both include a row of repeated similar figures across the top of a register. But the subject matter differs fundamentally: A shows anthropomorphic figures in robes with hand-held offerings and rows of small script-like signs, while B shows quadrupeds, a large bird in profile and a snake-like form with no human figures or sign-rows, and the rendering conventions (fine incised linear detail vs. bold rounded modelled relief) are unalike.
